name: smart-ledger-pro
description: Smart ledger web app packaged for Android with update detection.

scripts.android:copy: npm run build:web && npx cap copy android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
